title: Vibe Coding Glossary: Every Term You Need to Know in 2026
summary: The definitive vibe coding glossary — from AI app builder to zero-config deployment, every term defined clearly for founders, non-technical builders, and developers new to the space.
body_markdown: Traditional no-code (Bubble, Webflow, Glide) is visual drag-and-drop — you configure logic through a UI. Vibe coding is AI-generation — you describe what you want and the AI builds it. Vibe coding is faster for new builds; traditional no-code gives more granular control for complex configurations.
